build.//: Four profiles, one per thing we actually need to hand someone.

preview.//: The APK we sideload onto a real device to record the demo and to prove the push loop. Sideloadable, not a store artifact.

testers.//: Google Play closed testing. An AAB, because Play will not take an APK for a release track. Same artifact shape as production so the 14-day tester clock runs against what actually ships.

production.//: Google Play production and the Samsung Galaxy Store. Galaxy accepts this same AAB, which is the whole reason Door A costs no extra build.
